alt: A Discord forum's posts, a text channel's messages and an announcement's rich embed are read as one item each, rendered as text, split into chunks, embedded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and stored in the discord_embeddings table in Postgres, each row with its title and a link back to Discord; a reply to one post re-embeds only that post, and the query "notes stop syncing in the morning" returns the post "Sync stops after my laptop wakes from sleep".
needs: Discord bot in your server (Message Content intent on)

run.note: Configure (set DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN and DISCORD_CHANNEL_IDS in .env) and install
Optional: fill the channels with made-up posts through their webhooks
Build the index (re-run after the channels change)

run.cmd: python main.py "notes stop syncing in the morning"
